title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling samples, and docs site updates
author: Lena Park
release_notes: Added RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling example apps, and docs site navigation for agent templates. No breaking changes.
description:
Motivation: Provide opinionated quickstarts and end-to-end examples for building RAG-based agents with Redwood's tool-calling primitives. This PR bundles: (1) three RAG agent quickstarts (node/python/go) that show embeddings lookup -> tool call -> streaming response, (2) a small tool-calling sample library and example tools (search, calendar, stubbed DB), and (3) docs site updates: new navigation entries, tutorial pages, and copy edits.

What changed (high level):
- examples/rag-quickstarts/: New quickstart repos for node/python/go with README, workflow, and minimal infra.
- docs/site/content/docs/agents/: New tutorial pages and updated sidebar config.
- redwood-sdk-*: small helper additions to make tool-calling ergonomics consistent across SDKs.
- examples/tools/: sample tool implementations used by the quickstarts (mock search, calendar, and a simple REST tool).

Checklist: 
- [x] Quickstarts implemented and smoke-tested locally
- [x] Docs pages written and linked in sidebar
- [x] Unit tests added for example tools (basic end-to-end mocks)
- [x] CI builds passing
- [x] Reviewed by UX/docs

Migration notes: Existing agent templates unchanged; quickstarts are opt-in examples. No config changes required for customers.

Testing notes: Ran examples against local dev server and hosted sandbox. CI matrix covers node/python/go examples on ubuntu-latest.

Related: Linear ENG-1423 adds RAG quickstarts epic. References to prior RAG docs PRs and the agent templates RFC.
